messages:
jordan_csm: Heads-up: several private/VPC onboarders had failed embedding imports after a scheduled credentials rotation. I flagged 6 tenants, two are renewal-risk. Need a short status note + a tailored outreach for the two high-touch ones.

nina_cs: thanks. can you drop the tenant IDs and whether theyare in EU/APAC? i'll prepare the renewal-risk messaging.

jordan_csm: posted list in drive (link). 4 EU, 2 APAC. failures show as 403 on S3 get_object during batch ingest. no evidence of data corruption; files remained intact.

devon_se: quick tech summary: during automated key rotation the VPC role policy used by our ingestion worker was missing the `s3:GetObject` permission for a subset of customer buckets (private deployments with custom bucket policies). rotation rolled back at 11:18 UTC; replay started.

ryan_ops: we ran a targeted replay and manual fetch for the two renewal-risk tenants to minimize impact. backlog about ~8k files across all affected tenants; estimated catch-up window 3-8 hours depending on tenant size.

sam_support: i'll open support tickets now and add the canned template. do we want to offer credits or other remediation language?

jordan_csm: propose wording: offer "account credit or a complimentary onboarding assistance session" and for renewal-risk accounts add an offer for a dedicated engineer for a manual expedite. Also schedule a private office-hours slot for affected private deployments.

nina_cs: i'll soften the credit phrasing for enterprise buyers: "we're prepared to provide account credit and prioritized engineering support". for one high-touch tenant we should call first before sending email.

devon_se: RCA short line for customers: "Cause: during a scheduled credential rotation a role policy change temporarily prevented our ingestion service from reading files in some private buckets, which delayed processing. No files were lost." keep it brief and non-technical.

ryan_ops: note for compliance customers: we can produce a signed log export and timestamps of rotation/replay if requested.

jordan_csm: draft status note below. please flag edits, i'll send in 15m unless objections.

```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We want to let you know about a temporary delay that affected embedding imports for customers using private/VPC deployments during a scheduled credential rotation on 2026-03-23 between 10:5011:18 UTC. Some multi-file imports returned access errors and were delayed. No files were lost; we have rolled back the rotation, deployed a fix, and are replaying queued jobs.

Expected timeframe: most impacted tenants will complete within 3 hours; we'll follow up with targeted ETAs in your support ticket.

What weare doing: prioritizing affected tenants, offering account credit and prioritized engineering support, and hosting a private office hours session for affected private deployments. If this impacts a launch or contractual milestone, reply and we'll assign a dedicated engineer immediately.

Cause (brief): a role policy change during credential rotation temporarily removed read permission for some private buckets, which delayed ingestion.

Compliance note: if your audit team requires logs or a signed timeline for this window, tell us and we'll provide them.

We will send a follow-up RCA within 48 hours and remain available for immediate remediation.

Regards,
Jordan, Customer Success
```

sam_support: approved. creating tickets now and tagging csms + eng.

nina_cs: i'll call the top renewal-risk tenant first, then email the others. i'll mirror the softer credit language for them.

devon_se: i'll prepare the 48h RCA and include a technical appendix for audit teams.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-300 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-300 - status: mitigated, severity: P2, notes: credential rotation rollback, replays ongoing.

jordan_csm: action items: 1) sam: tickets + template (10m) 2) nina: phone top renewal-risk then send targeted emails (20m) 3) devon/ryan: 48h RCA + signed logs if requested. 4) i'll schedule a private office hours slot for affected customers.

ryan_ops: replay prioritized for renewal-risk tenants complete for one, second in progress.

jordan_csm: great, please drop any customer replies here and i'll coordinate follow-ups. thanks everyone :heart:
